acceptance_criteria.description: RuntimeBuildIdentity, StableRuntimeSession, and RuntimeLeaseFence expose the exact closed fields through validated strong types and reject malformed or unknown JSON.
Additive conversions from CompatibilityTarget, LeaseFence, and LeaseContract preserve every stable value without changing existing save-fence constructors or serialized contracts.

Tests prove revision independence; inequality for every currently multi-valued build/session dimension; and explicit conversion plus strict-JSON preservation of singleton bridge ABI and protocol dimensions without claiming singleton inequality.
Cloud tests, strict clippy, workspace check, formatting, metadata, and diff checks pass with changes confined to owned_files.

closed_decisions: RuntimeBuildIdentity consists exactly of game_build_id, rom_sha256, mgba_version, bridge_abi, and protocol_version. Save revision is deliberately absent.
StableRuntimeSession consists exactly of session_id, character_id, session_epoch, and client_instance_id. Save revision, lease expiry, heartbeat cadence, and secrets are absent.
RuntimeLeaseFence nests the stable session and build identities; all JSON is strict and reuses validated strong types.
CompatibilityTarget, LeaseFence, and LeaseContract retain their existing fields, constructors, serialization, and save-fencing semantics. New conversions and accessors are additive.

Equality tests must prove revision independence and inequality for every dimension whose strong type currently admits multiple valid values: game_build_id, rom_sha256, mgba_version, session_id, character_id, session_epoch, and client_instance_id.

BridgeAbiVersion and ProtocolVersion currently admit only value 1. Tests must prove those singleton fields are present, preserved by conversion, and round-trip in strict JSON. They must not falsely claim an impossible inequality test. When a future validated value is admitted, its owning change must add the corresponding inequality regression.
forbidden_changes: Do not edit ids.rs, server/launcher/sidecar/protocol/save/bridge/ROM code, Cargo manifests or lockfiles, documentation, or orchestration state outside owned_files.
Do not add a test-only invalid constructor, unsafe layout trick, deserialization bypass, or broaden BridgeAbiVersion/ProtocolVersion solely to manufacture inequality evidence.
Do not add save revision, expiry, credentials, channels, maps, regions, or mutable runtime state to these identity records.
Do not change existing save lease wire formats or constructors.
Do not stage, commit, branch, fetch, pull, push, contact remotes, or revert others' work.
objective: Finalize additive, revision-independent cloud runtime identities for authenticated world presence and replace the rejected singleton-version test claim with exact structural-preservation evidence.

return_when: Every acceptance criterion is resolved and verification outcomes are recorded.
A required change would broaden a singleton version type or cross owned_files.
